name: HomenetSpain
summary: Website for a Costa del Sol real estate agency, architected and built from the ground up with a fast, powerful property search engine.

name: Voota
summary: Nonprofit platform encouraging citizen participation in politics, where people can learn about and publish opinions on politicians and parties.

name: Mumumio
summary: A food marketplace of independent shops: people could review sellers, discover new products, and group purchases to reduce shipping costs.

name: Kakoe
summary: Themed chat where participants log in with Facebook to talk about what they are watching on TV, with comments also shared to Facebook and Twitter.

name: ShopiAds
summary: Turns Shopify product collections into dynamic advertisements for other sites, customizable in color and size. One of the first apps in the Shopify App Store.

name: Wanna Wine?
summary: A Facebook app to discover new wines: users review a few wines to teach the app their taste, then get recommendations for similar bottles.

name: rmbrME

name: First 5 Santa Clara County
summary: A Drupal theme generated from Photoshop templates for an organization supporting early childhood development.

name: Grupo 3 Limousine Voyager
summary: Site for a tourist and business transfer cooperative, with a custom CMS and an integrated transfer booking flow.

name: Está de feria
summary: A map of the Algeciras and La Línea fairs with events, voting, and chat, so visitors could follow each stand.

name: Algeciras Party
